balls.text: and a poor delivery to end the innings, length ball on the pads, with fine leg up, and Badri flicks it over the fielder
and the hat-trick ball does well to land on the wicket, slower bouncer gone horribly wrong, way outside off
Watson is on a hat-trick! slower ball, and Dhoni doesn't get power into the shot down the ground, and long-on does the rest
end of a superb innings from Vijay! Finally he mis-hits one and holes out to deep midwicket! He walks out to a unanimous standing ovation. Take a bow
high elbow and all that! Again Watson misses the yorker length not even by one foot, and he chips it over extra cover, straight into the boundary rope! Highest IPL total
smacked too powerfully to mid-off and the single is not on. But he had to go for it anyway, and Narwal's direct-hit finds him short
well bowled, yorker outside off, Morkel is beaten on an attempt to run it down to third man
low full toss, and this is not wide enough of Vijay who gets enough bat on it to beat deep point - the partnership is now worth 150-plus
yorker on off stump, limply hit towards long-on, and because it hasn't been hit powerfully they steal a second
Tait flirting with the wide line, and and has managed to stay inside it, and still wide enough of Vijay. Well bowled
smartly bowled, full and wide yorker, beating a backing-away Morkel, but they sneak in a bye here
makes room, Tait bowls full and wide, but Vijay gets bat on it and then a single to third man
follows a backing-up Morkel with a full delivery, who gets a single to mid-on
eat your heart out MS Dhoni! This is Dhoni-like hitting! Setting up early, taking a ball that has missed the yorker length by inches, and whiplashes it over long-on
slower ball, short, and deliberately cut uppishly to clear the infield, gets a couple
first streaky boundary for Vijay! Perhaps the first mis-hit! Makes room and slogs, gets an inside edge past short fine leg
Umm, I am not going to repeat what Gauti said! It's a top-edged skier that hasn't gone far off the pitch. three fielders get under it, Ojha calls for it, and lets it slip right through
slower ball, cut away from in front of stumps, doesn't find the gap, gets a single
what a way to get to his hundred! Smashes a length ball down the ground, past mid-off, takes three steps down the pitch, and pumps his fists. Take a bow Vijay
this is what happens when Morkel connects with the slog! Into the crowd behind deep midwicket, no trouble at all! It was nicely flighted and in Morkel's zone
flighted on the pads, slogged away, not well hit but wide of deep square and gets him four
Vijay almost runs himself out! Off Morkel's pad, but it hasn't gone too far away from Ojha, and Morkel sends Vijay back. A wide throw saves Vijay here
Vijay jumps out of the crease a fraction too soon, but Warne's short delivery is not quick enough to beat him
turn and bounce outside off, and beats him on the cut
flights on the pads, mis-hit but along the ground for one to deep midwicket - fifty up for Morkel
Disdain was never more disdainful, another slower ball, and again he waits and waits and launches it over long-on. Vijay can't hit anything unsweetly here! On 96 now. Nine sixes in it
bye bye ball! slower ball, but Vijay waits and waits for it and sends it over cow corner. Crazy hitting going on
another length ball, and Narwal is lucky Morkel doesn't get under it, and gets just a single to long-off
poor poor bowling! Length ball at 124ks, and Morkel clears his front leg and sends it straight into the camera at the top tier - 100-run stand in 43 balls
nice comeback with a yorker, and Vijay digs it out for a single
and he is not being shown respect either! Poor bowling! Length ball at gentle pace, and he clears his front leg and sends it sailing over cow corner
slower ball, guided from in front of stumps for a single to third man
Tait goes a full and wide yorker, and ends up bowling it too wide
Show some respect Vijay! This is a man bowling bouncers at close to 150ks, and he is expecting just that. And he has backed away and walloped it over midwicket, onto the roof, and out of the stadium!
this is a better short delivery, cramping him up, making him fend at it
short and wide and this he has used the pace as though the term was coined for this act of his, upper-cutting him over third man for another big six
can't beat extra cover this time, but takes a single nonetheless
incredible shot! sits back in the shot, and this is nearly a yorker but he turns it into a half-volley by staying deep in the crease, and then drives it past extra cover
another slog, along the ground, gets a single to long-on
same shot, but slightly more graceful, because it is a cleaner strike and straighter, and clears long-on easily
old-fashioned biff! clears his front leg and slogs it to cow corner for four
makes room, is too far from it to get power, but gets a single
crash! dances down the track and sends him sailing into the crowd behind deep midwicket. H.U.G.E
lovely late-cut, from out of the keeper's gloves, and superbly placed, almost as if he knew a flat delivery was coming
swiped away past midwicket for two
on the pads, worked away for a single
turn and bounce, beats him on the cut shot
what a way to bring up his fifty! what a way to treat Warne! dances down the track, is not quite to the pitch of it, but makes room and swings it high and clean over the sight screen
slid across him, and he takes a single to third man
terrible delivery from Warne, and by Warne's standards, it is, well, ordinary. Short in his half, and down the leg side, and he is duly pulled over deep square for leg for six more
flat on the pads, worked around the corner
bunted into the covers for one
makes room, dabs it to backward point for one
that's Albie's shot! Clears his front leg, and sends this flat and straight, lusty blow
guided past backward point and comes back for two
Watson's first boundary in the IPL! through a wild wild throw from midwicket that beats everybody on its way to extra cover for four extra runs
slightly fuller this time, but can't drive it still, played back to the bowler. So two good overs for RR in a row
pulled off the front foot, wide of deep midwicket, comes back for two
shimmies down the track and pushes a shortish delivery to wide long-on
bunted past point for a single
makes room and cuts this from outside leg, gets only a single, though
flat on the pads, helped away for a single
shorter and cut away from in front of stumps for a single
four dots in a row, again flighted on the pads, no room to swing his arms, and he defends it back to Jhunjhunwala
sharp offbreak, gets a thick edge to short third
overpitched on middle and leg, hit back to the bowler
flighted on the pads, defended
Vijay charges down, is short of the pitch of the ball, gets a single to midwicket, Watson's throw gets Morkel in the lower back
full toss on the pads again, and worked away to midwicket for one
nice dip there, Vijay defends the legbreak

big legbreak, pitches short outside off, and turns back in and beats everybody - Ojha not really expecting a legbreak from Warne. As Ojha will learn, you do that at your own peril. The ball beats everybody and goes for three byes
low full toss and drilled down the ground, straight of long-off
another soft wicket! Full and wide, would have been called wide had Raina not flirted with it, and he has to really reach out for it, and the edge settles safely at point
full toss on the pads, flicked away for a single
nicely timed cover-drive, mid-off gets a hand to it and saves two runs
slower ball, into the pads, single taken to fine leg
swiped away from in front of stumps, gets a single to deep square
short ball, not much pace on it, and pulled away to deep square leg
nice bouncer, follows him as he sways out of the line, well done both batter and bowler
back of a length, no room, defended to cover
full outside off, driven square for a single
steered away to third man, and a needless direct hit from the deep lets them come through for the overthrow
half-volley on the pads, and helped away for another boundary past leg slip
tip and run here
short and wide, and edged away over slips, one bounce for four. Pace is his enemy here
back of a length on off, no room, defended back
More ordinary stuff here, bowls a gentle length ball on the pads, and Raina says thank you very much for letting him get off the mark with an easy boundary past the leg slip
soft dismissal! full and wide half-volley, and he has hit it straight down extra cover's throat. Wagh is thrilled, he has had his own back after three boundaries
this is ordinary bowling! short, into the pads, and he has been pulled for three boundaries in a row
and this has been clubbed! Walks down the pitch again, and flat-bats it over midwicket
fine leg is up, and Hayden walks down the track and drags this from middle to past short fine leg. Not a bad delivery at all
Hayden cuts this hard into the ground, gets a bottom edge as this is not short enough
Watson tries a bouncer, Vijay sways out of the line, dropping his wrists
length ball, driven hard down the ground, gets a single to mid-on

what a shot! what a welcome to Watson! Anticipates a short delivery after having down the pitch twice, and sits back in the crease and pulls a back-of-a-length delivery over midwicket for six! Not really a bad ball, but he manufactured the length here
walks down the track and pulls this slower ball to wide of deep midwicket, comes back for two
mis-hit but Hayden had all grounds covered here, walks down the track and goes for the big hit down the ground. There is no third man and hence the thick edge is safe. 1000 runs for Haydos in IPL
and Hayden drills a length delivery one bounce to Warne at silly mid-off
gets the length right, way shorter than a half-volley, but Hayden still drops it to mid-off for a single
half-volley on the pads, 143ks, and Hayden glances it past fine leg, using Tait's pace
back of a length, on the pads, hit back to the bowler
yorker outside off, digs it out to cover-point
short, tucking him up, but they steal a single to mid-on
slightly back of a length, wide outside off, Vijay misses on the cut shot
flat on the pads, worked around the corner
fired into the pads, helped away for a single
beautiful shot, charges down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball, and lofts him straight into the sight screen
on the pads, worked away for an easy single
makes room to cut this from in front of stumps, hits it one bounce to point
flat delivery, pushed back to the bowler
Vijay is taking Narwal to the cleaners! No respect there, charges down the track, and even though Narwal has bowled a slow wide delivery, he sends it crashing over cover
slightly shorter, and Vijay is expecting it, and has pulled it over midwicket, one bounce for four
two length balls in a row, and Vijay has taken a second invitation, lofting him over midwicket. At his pace, without swing, he can't be bowling length
length ball, driven into the ground, and straight to mid-on
dug in short, way down the leg side
Hayden walks down the track right away, gets an inside edge onto the pad, Vijay calls him through for a single
flighted delivery played with soft hands to mid-off
flighted on the pads, worked away past mid-on, superb timing, but it will just be a single to deep midwicket
short ball, cramps him up, hit straight to mid-on
quicker ball and Vijay makes room in a hurry and late-cuts it past London Bridge dive at backward point by Sumit Narwal
outside leg, worked away fine, let through by Shaun Tait at short fine leg
short ball into the body, turned away for a single
Ojha finishes a valiant innings with a pull to fine leg for a single, and Chennai has won this run feast
overpitched delivery, hit into the ground, gets a single
and Ojha can't get a century either, Raut swings and misses
skies this one, just wide of the bowler, Hayden is under it, and he drops it, but the single takes Ojha away from strike
lovely shot, slower ball, waits for it, gets under it, cuts over cover-point, four more - on 92 now
swings, gets a thick edge over the keeper

superb spell comes to an end, finishes off with a yorker just inside that white line that judges wides, and he gets a huge applause from the Chennai crowd, what an impression he has made right away - somewhat like Malinga on the Mumbai crowds
short, tucks him up, only a single to midwicket
gets a thick edge on the yorker, and again good field placement - third man is straight here

slower offcutter gets another wicket! 116ks, Jhunjhunwala makes good connection with it, muscling it down the ground, but Raina judges it well and catches it at mid-off. Good captaincy too, to have mid-off up for Bollinger
makes room, hits a back-of-a-length delivery to sweeper-cover for another single
makes room and hits a length delivery to sweeper-cover
now the delicate paddle sweep, past short fine off the pad, gets three runs for it
no respect for the highest wicket-taker in Tests! dances down first ball and hits him back over his head, six more
gets the late-cut right this time, but can't beat short third
Ojha looks for the delicate late-cut and is beaten
Ojha keeps swinging and gets into his 80s, getting under a length delivery and lofting it over deep square leg

after keeping Fazal on strike with his fielding in the last over, Murali gets hisd wicket too, nicely flighting an offbreak. Fazal gets the toe end of the bat while looking for the big shot, and lobs it to cover-point
hit to wide of long-on, they are pushing for two but Murali is too quick there
looks for the big shot over the leg side, swings too early, gets a leg-bye
follows Fazal who is backing away, and concedes just a single
just to make things right, bowls this yorker right on the stumps, only a single ensues
pauses in his delivery stride, bowls a yorker outside off, and the toe-edge squeezes past short third man
driven inside-out, Ojha on strike now
squeezes a low full toss past point, and fine of third man, Ojha is still fighting
slower offcutter this time, 121ks, and beats Ojha like he did Watson
lovely yorker, middle and leg, another dot ball
now Ojha gets uncomfortable pace, jumping around, makes room and offers an open face and is beaten
steered to third man for a single
another full toss, not over waist high, but down the leg side

Bollinger you beauty! slower off cutter, 122ks, beats Watson on the slog, gets the top of off! Smiles at Watson as he walks back, pats him on the back, says well played, Watson nods back. That's how it should be!
starts off with a beamer, outside off, guided away to third man for one
Watooooooo whadaplayaaaaa! Swept away over deep square leg, 15 rows back, lovely clean striking - and against Murali, no less
just for a change, defends a flighted delivery, perhaps there was dip on it
full on the pads, the delicate touch this time, sweeping it fine, past short fine leg
makes no difference to Watson, another sweep shot, another clean connection, and six more runs - brings up his fifty off 21 balls!
what a shot! into the second tier over midwicket and still climbing! slog-swept away from wide outside off
topspinner, and the attempted straight loft gets a thick edge that just about clears extra cover
charges down the wicket and hits him one bounce to long-on
short ball, pulled down to long-on for one
Watson rubs it in by driving a length ball over extra cover, and a bad bounce Hussey's slide at the boundary

another drop, this is well bowled, following the bouncer up with a slower ball that Watson skies towards midwicket, and Aniruddha Srikkant never really settled under it, and quite naturally dropped it
follows it up with a bouncer, it tails him too, moving in towards him, and beats him on the pull
slower ball and it beats his slog sweep - he saw the slower ball but just couldn't time the shot quite right
beats him with one that nips away, and quite harshly it's called a wide
gives him the charge and throws his bat at it again, and the outside edge beats third man - big over for Rajasthan
turning towards him from outside leg, beats him, but Watto gets a leg-bye
short ball, hit to extra cover, and they come through for one
superb shot, are we on to something? Comes down the track and makes room at the same time, and lofts him over the sight screen
swept from in front of leg stump, gets a single to deep fine leg
lovely shot, back of a length, Watto goes deep into the crease and hammers him over long-on - partnership now 50 off 25
tosses up a dossra this time, Watson comes forward and opens the face to get a single to short third man
good strike again, stays deep in the crease and pulls this back-of-a-length delivery with the turn, over deep square leg
guides a doosra down to short third for a single
another tospinner, beautifully bowled, bounces viciously at him as he tries to sweep this one
back of a length, hit down to long-on
starts off with a toppie, Ojha bunts it to cover for one
looks to cut but it is too full for the shot, and gets a big bottom edge into Dhoni's pads - would be unfair to call it a drop
comes down the track and bunts this one into the leg side to bring up his fifty
hit too powerfully to extra cover to be coming through for one
lovely, clean, straight, flighted up to him, and he lofts it over long-off
angled into the pads, worked away to fine leg for one
through Hayden's legs at cover-point, who is done in by the spin on the square cut
slower ball, and he gets under it and pulls it to the midwicket boundary
Oof what power! Both Morkel and Rudi do well to get out of the way of this straight hit
full toss, crashes past extra cover, all along the ground
driven down to long-on for a single
slower ball, driven down to long-on for one
length ball, driven to midwicket for a single
driven inside-out, gets a single to sweeper-cover
cut away fine for a single
dropped by Badri at deep midwicket, running in and misjudging a low catch
Ojha is not going down without swinging, charges down the track and lofts him straight into the sight screen
flat delivery, pushed down to long-on for one

oh Bollinger you beauty! Pathan has mis-hit this into the stratosphere, but Bollinger settles himself at the edge of long-on boundary, stretches behind his body to take the catch, and while off balance, throws the ball back into the play, takes a step outside field of play,and comes back to complete the catch. That's wicked stuff for a fast bowler who is not one of the most mobile units you will see. The beauty is, he tried to resist the momentum, then saw he couldn't do that, and then threw it back!
and he is expecting a bouncer first up, and pulls it in front of square, one bounce for four
shuffles across to try and beat short fine leg, but only manages to hit it square for a single
slower ball, and Ojha plays a similar shot as Lumb, but he gets enough power behind this and clears sweeper-cover
hits a length ball straight down sweeper-cover's throat. He had to go for everything here, hit this with an open face, and holes out
driven down the ground for a single to long-on
and now he teases, loopy offbreak, pitching leg, inviting a slog-sweep, and beating him
quick delivery, just back of a length, punched to backward point
long hop, and Lumb is quick to rock back and pull it square of deep midwicket
flatter delivery, stays back, and places it in covers for one
textbook forward defensive to an offbreak pitched middle and leg
doosra, spinning away from the same spot, gets a thick edge, along the ground
starts round the wicket, pitches leg and it turns down the leg side
cramps him up with a short one, but he manages to get it to third man for a single
lovely shot, length ball on off stump, and he goes inside-out, making room, and chipping it neatly
short ball, hurries him a touch, but he manges to find the gap on the on side with this pull shot
slower ball, sets himself up for the big hit, waits, and hits it two bounces to deep midwicket
short, into the body, pulled away to deep square leg for one
back of a length, and Ojha lofts it over mid-off
slammed away for a six, short and he gets slightly inside it and pulls it over midwicket
short ball, looks for the pull, is beaten by extra bounce
short ball now, and tucked away to square leg for one
that's the pace and length Ojha is used to, length ball, medium pace, and he lofts this one over midwicket
dropped at cover-point by Raina, would have been a superb catch had he held onto it with that dive to his left
gets inside the line by shuffling across, and gets it past short fine
short and quick again, no room again, defended
gets a thick edge on the cut, third man is square and it will be just one
follows it up with a yorker, not much Lumb can do with it
phew, what a bouncer, 141ks, surprises Lumb with the way it came up, and then clears Dhoni's head
looks to pull, but this is slightly too full for the shot
tucks him up, this time he drops it fine of square leg and gets a single
steps down the track, and clears cover ring with a mis-hit
gets a top edge as he tries to pull one that is not short enough, and it clears short fine
cut away, but straight to cover-point
good use of the bouncer, right over the middle stump, and right at his throat
Lumb looking desperate, steps down, makes room, swings and misses
hurries him up in this flick down the leg side, gets a leg-bye
starts with a wide down the leg side
and finally he pitches one up, right up, yorker, just outside off, what an over
Lumb gives him the charge, Bollinger stays short and fast, and there is no connection between bat and ball
and again he hurries him up with a shortish delivery, 144ks, gets an inside edge onto his thigh
still back of a length, 143ks, tucking him up, another dot ball
stays short, doesn't give him any room, Ojha defends
And Douggy Bollinger announces himself some more with a short ball that hurries onto Ojha and has him fending
lovely shot! deliberately he short-arms this cut shot to avoid the third man fielder. Good start for Rajasthan
steps down the wicket, gets the bottom part of the bat
brings fine leg up, and offers him a length ball on the pads, and Lumb obliges with a flick past the short fine leg
Doug B announces himself with a tumbling save at deep square leg, lovely stop to prevent this punch off the hips from going for four
edged, and wide of slip, genuine edge here with the offcutter, but edge loops past first slip
and the first ball gets big on him, from back of a length, towards his throat, making him fend at it
